entry_state: Claim dependence and fitted reserve uncertainty do not alone identify future payments. Bootstrap validity depends on the conditioning information, process law, backward law and correct reserve centering. Even a justified payment law leaves the insurer compensation measure to choose. The new finite example defines that additional amount and begins the atom-aware upper-tail calculation.
exit_state: The risk-measure discussion preserves probability atoms, nonnegative PH support, future information and conditional-mean assumptions. Capital charges require their own timing and entity choices. The reserving exchange then preserves entire joint draws, failed cells and restart state; completion of computation supplies neither probability admission nor runtime validation.
findings: The tail calculation distinguishes exact quantile equivalence from cumulative coverage and retains only the required boundary mass.
The PH weights are derived from survival differences; the accepted-manuscript sign error and uninspected final edition remain clearly distinguished.
Future conditional standard deviations, their root mean square and present uncertainty are different quantities. Additive revision variances require true conditional means.
The adapter preserves computational failure separately from zero payment and structural absence. No new confirmed manuscript defect.
